fields.name: MS365_MCP_TENANT_ID
fields.label: Which Microsoft account?
fields.help: Pick the kind you sign in to Outlook with.

options.label: Work or school account
options.help: One your workplace or school gave you.

fields.name: MS365_MCP_EXPECTED_USERNAME
fields.label: Your Microsoft email
fields.help: Only this account can sign in. Any other account is refused and its sign-in deleted.

fields.name: MS365_MCP_CLIENT_ID
fields.label: Your firm's app ID (needed for a work account)
fields.help: The Application (client) ID of the app your Microsoft 365 admin registered for Iron Jarvis (the Handbook has the steps). A personal account can leave it empty.
